# Data Total

pipeline de imputación

```{r}
path <- "data/data2022-2025.csv"
df   <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)  # respeta "PM2.5"
```

# Filtrar por CE, NTE2, NE

```{r}
df <- subset(df, LOCATION %in% c("CE","NE","NTE2"))

df

```

## Valores negativos a nulos

```{r}
cols <- intersect(c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5",
                    "PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT",
                    "WSR","WDR","YEAR"), names(df))

df[cols] <- Map(function(v, nm) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  if (nm == "TOUT") {
    v[v < -50 | v > 100] <- NA                 # Temperatura
  } else if (nm == "PM2.5") {
    v[v < 0 | v > 500] <- NA                   # Regla nueva PM2.5
  } else if (nm == "PM10") {
    v[v < 0 | v > 600] <- NA                   # Regla nueva PM10
  } else {
    v[v < 0] <- NA                             # Regla general
  }
  v
}, df[cols], names(df[cols]))

```

## Conteo de nulos

```{r}
na_pct_col    <- round(colMeans(is.na(df)) * 100, 2)
na_pct_global <- round(100 * sum(is.na(df)) / (nrow(df) * ncol(df)), 2)

na_pct_col
na_pct_global

colSums(is.na(df))

```


```{r}
summary(df)
```

```{r}

# Completa NAs largos (>60 h) usando las otras estaciones como donantes.
# 1) Primero interpola huecos <7 h (lineal).
# 2) Para NAs restantes en rachas >60 h, predice con regresión usando las otras dos estaciones.
# Crea columnas *_filled (no modifica las originales).

library(zoo)

df$DATE <- as.POSIXct(df$DATE, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC")
df <- df[order(df$LOCATION, df$DATE), ]

stations <- c("CE","NE","NTE2")
vars <- intersect(c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR"), names(df))
for (v in vars) df[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[v]]))

udates <- sort(unique(df$DATE))  # rejilla horaria común

for (v in vars) {
  out_col <- paste0(v, "_filled")
  df[[out_col]] <- NA_real_

  # Serie por estación alineada a 'udates'
  series <- lapply(stations, function(s){
    vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(udates))
    idxs <- which(df$LOCATION == s)
    pos  <- match(df$DATE[idxs], udates)
    vals[pos] <- df[[v]][idxs]
    vals
  })
  names(series) <- stations

  # Paso 1: interpolación de huecos < 7 h
  series <- lapply(series, function(x) na.approx(x, maxgap = 7, na.rm = FALSE))

  # Paso 2: rellenar rachas > 60 h con regresión usando donantes
  for (s in stations) {
    x  <- series[[s]]
    others <- setdiff(stations, s)
    d1 <- series[[others[1]]]
    d2 <- series[[others[2]]]

    r <- rle(is.na(x)); ends <- cumsum(r$lengths); starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1
    mask <- r$values & r$lengths > 60
    if (any(mask)) {
      long_idx <- unlist(mapply(seq, starts[mask], ends[mask]))
      # Modelos: y ~ d1 + d2 ; y ~ d1 ; y ~ d2
      train_df12 <- data.frame(y = x, d1 = d1, d2 = d2)
      fit12 <- tryCatch(lm(y ~ d1 + d2, data = train_df12, na.action = na.omit), error = function(e) NULL)

      train_df1  <- data.frame(y = x, d1 = d1)
      fit1  <- tryCatch(lm(y ~ d1, data = train_df1, na.action = na.omit), error = function(e) NULL)

      train_df2  <- data.frame(y = x, d2 = d2)
      fit2  <- tryCatch(lm(y ~ d2, data = train_df2, na.action = na.omit), error = function(e) NULL)

      # Predicciones según disponibilidad de donantes en cada instante
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(long_idx))
      has12 <- !is.na(d1[long_idx]) & !is.na(d2[long_idx]) & !is.null(fit12)
      if (any(has12)) {
        pred[has12] <- predict(fit12, newdata = data.frame(d1 = d1[long_idx][has12], d2 = d2[long_idx][has12]))
      }
      has1 <- is.na(pred) & !is.na(d1[long_idx]) & !is.null(fit1)
      if (any(has1)) {
        pred[has1] <- predict(fit1, newdata = data.frame(d1 = d1[long_idx][has1]))
      }
      has2 <- is.na(pred) & !is.na(d2[long_idx]) & !is.null(fit2)
      if (any(has2)) {
        pred[has2] <- predict(fit2, newdata = data.frame(d2 = d2[long_idx][has2]))
      }

      # Asigna (y evita negativos por coherencia física)
      x[long_idx[!is.na(pred)]] <- pmax(pred[!is.na(pred)], 0)
    }

    # Vuelca al data frame original para la estación s
    idxs <- which(df$LOCATION == s)
    pos  <- match(df$DATE[idxs], udates)
    df[[out_col]][idxs] <- x[pos]
  }
}

# Resultado: columnas *_filled (ej. CO_filled, NO_filled, ...),
# con huecos <7h por interpolación y huecos >60h usando estaciones vecinas.

```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(df))
```

```{r}
# Imputa los NAs restantes usando “climatología”:
# para cada NA (día y hora), toma la MEDIANA de los 3 meses anteriores
# en AÑOS ANTERIORES, misma estación, mismo día-del-mes y misma hora.
# Si no hay datos, relaja a: (meses previos + misma hora) -> (todas las horas del mismo año previo) -> mediana de la estación.
# Crea columnas *_final s

df$DATE <- as.POSIXct(df$DATE, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC")
df <- df[order(df$LOCATION, df$DATE), ]
df$Year  <- as.integer(format(df$DATE, "%Y"))
df$Month <- as.integer(format(df$DATE, "%m"))
df$Day   <- as.integer(format(df$DATE, "%d"))
df$Hour  <- as.integer(format(df$DATE, "%H"))

vars <- intersect(c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR"), names(df))
for (v in vars) df[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[v]]))

get_base <- function(v) {
  vf <- paste0(v, "_filled")
  vi <- paste0(v, "_imp")
  if (vf %in% names(df)) df[[vf]]
  else if (vi %in% names(df)) df[[vi]]
  else df[[v]]
}

prev3 <- function(m) ((m - 1 - 1:3) %% 12) + 1  # 3 meses anteriores con wrap

fill_clim_station <- function(d, v) {
  x <- get_base(v)[d$idx]
  na_idx <- which(is.na(x))
  if (!length(na_idx)) return(x)

  for (i in na_idx) {
    y0 <- d$Year[i]; m0 <- d$Month[i]; d0 <- d$Day[i]; h0 <- d$Hour[i]
    mset <- prev3(m0)

    donors <- d[[v]][ d$Year < y0 & d$Month %in% mset & d$Day == d0 & d$Hour == h0 ]
    val <- suppressWarnings(median(donors, na.rm = TRUE))

    if (is.na(val)) {
      donors <- d[[v]][ d$Year < y0 & d$Month %in% mset & d$Hour == h0 ]
      val <- suppressWarnings(median(donors, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
    if (is.na(val)) {
      donors <- d[[v]][ d$Year < y0 & d$Hour == h0 ]
      val <- suppressWarnings(median(donors, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
    if (is.na(val)) {
      val <- suppressWarnings(median(d[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
    }

    # coherencia física básica
    if (!is.na(val)) {
      if (v %in% c("RH"))  val <- min(max(val, 0), 100)
      if (v %in% c("WDR")) val <- (val %% 360)
      if (v %in% c("PM10")) val <- if (val >= 900) NA_real_ else max(val, 0)
      if (v %in% c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM2.5","SO2","PRS","RAINF","SR","TOUT","WSR")) val <- max(val, 0)
      x[i] <- val
    }
  }
  x
}

df$idx <- seq_len(nrow(df))
out_list <- lapply(split(df, df$LOCATION), function(d){
  d <- d[order(d$DATE), ]
  d$idx <- d$idx
  for (v in vars) {
    d[[paste0(v, "_final")]] <- fill_clim_station(d, v)
  }
  d
})

df_final <- do.call(rbind, out_list)
df_final <- df_final[order(df_final$idx), ]
# Resultado: columnas *_final con imputación por climatología de 3 meses previos en años anteriores.

```


```{r}
colSums(is.na(df_final))

```


## Guardado final

```{r}
base <- if (exists("df_final")) df_final else df

final_vars <- c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")
time_cols  <- intersect(c("Year","Month","Day","Hour","YEAR","MONTH","DAY","HOUR"), names(base))
keep_cols  <- c(time_cols, paste0(final_vars, "_final"))
keep_cols  <- intersect(keep_cols, names(base))

out <- base[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
names(out) <- sub("_(final|finnal)$", "", names(out))  # quita _final (o _finnal si estaba mal escrito)

```

```{r}
summary(out)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(out))

```

```{r}
write.csv(out, "DATA_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
